recipes.title: Mexican turkey skillet
recipes.summary: One pan: 93% turkey, peppers, black beans, salsa. Rice + avocado on the side.
steps: Brown turkey in a skillet with onion and bell pepper, 8–10 min.
Stir in beans, cumin, chili powder, salt, and salsa. Simmer 3 min.
Heat rice pouch. Plate with avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Greek chicken thighs + cucumber salad
recipes.summary: Oregano-garlic thighs, pan or sheet. Cold cucumber-tomato-feta salad.
steps: Toss thighs with oil, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper.
Sear or roast at 425°F until 165°F, about 18–20 min.
Chop cucumber, tomato, onion. Dress with oil, lemon, feta.

recipes.title: Garlic-ginger shrimp stir-fry
recipes.summary: Hot pan, EZ-peel shrimp, broccoli, soy. Rice pouch.
steps: Peel shrimp if needed. Heat skillet until almost smoking.
Garlic and ginger 30 sec, then shrimp 2 min.
Add broccoli and pepper. Splash soy. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-pan salmon + corn + potatoes
recipes.summary: Potatoes first, then salmon and corn. Lemon and parsley to finish.
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with oil and salt. Roast 10 min.
Add salmon and corn. Roast 12–14 min more.
